reply.subject: Re: wireless in the library
reply.body: Join the CODID-Students network using your campus username (not your email alias) and password; if it keeps failing, forget the network first and then rejoin. If you need quick internet before class, CODID-Guest is open for 24 hours, but it does not reach internal servers. Because your class starts in ten minutes, I'm flagging this for a specialist in case you need further help. Please try rejoining CODID-Students now and reply if it still fails.
